[EN] The giants' holy power—perhaps their whole empire—hinged on the relics we're recovering. I'm sure I needn't convince you of that.

Soon the Mysterium will be able to recreate that power.
[ES] El poder sagrado de los gigantes —tal vez todo su imperio— dependía de las reliquias que estamos recuperando. Seguro que no necesito convencerte de eso.

Pronto el Mysterium podrá recrear ese poder.
